source_text:
Μαρτύριον τοῦ ἁγίου Πολυκάρπου.

Ἡ ἐκκλησία τοῦ θεοῦ ἡ παροικοῦσα Σμύρναν, τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ τῇ παροικούσῃ ἐν Φιλομηλίῳ καὶ πάσαις ταῖς κατὰ πάντα τόπον τῆς ἁγίας καὶ καθολικῆς ἐκκλησίας παροικίαις· ἔλεος καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ ἀγάπη θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ πληθυνθείη.

I. Ἐγράψαμεν ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὰ κατὰ τοὺς μαρτυρήσαντας καὶ τὸν μακάριον Πολύκαρπον, ὅστις ὥσπερ ἐπισφραγίσας διὰ τῆς μαρτυρίας αὐτοῦ κατέπαυσε τὸν διωγμόν. Σχεδὸν γὰρ πάντα τὰ προάγοντα ἐγένετο, ἵνα ἡμῖν ὁ κύριος ἄνωθεν ἐπιδείξῃ τὸ κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον μαρτύριον. Περιέμενεν γὰρ ἵνα παραδοθῇ, ὡς καὶ ὁ κύριος, ἵνα μιμηταὶ καὶ ἡμεῖς αὐτοῦ γενώμεθα, μὴ μόνον σκοποῦντες τὸ κατ᾽ ἑαυτούς, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸ κατὰ τοὺς πέλας. Ἀγάπης γὰρ ἀληθοῦς καὶ βεβαίας ἐστὶν μὴ μόνον ἑαυτὸν θέλειν σώζεσθαι, ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφούς.
thought_title: Polycarp waited to be handed over and sealed the persecution
orientation: The church in Smyrna writes to the church in Philomelium to present Polycarp as the model of martyrdom according to the gospel.
pass_a_gloss: Martyrdom of the holy Polycarp. The church of God the one sojourning at Smyrna to the church of God the one sojourning at Philomelium and to all the sojournings in every place of the holy and universal church. Mercy and peace and love of God the father and of our lord Jesus Christ may be multiplied. We wrote to you brothers the things concerning those who suffered martyrdom and the blessed Polycarp who as having sealed by his martyrdom brought to an end the persecution. For nearly all the preceding things happened in order that the lord from above might show to us the martyrdom according to the gospel. For he was waiting in order that he might be handed over as also the lord in order that imitators also we of him might become not only looking at the thing in respect to ourselves but also the thing in respect to neighbors. For it is of true and firm love not only to wish oneself to be saved but also all the brothers.

pass_b_english: The church of God sojourning at Smyrna to the church of God sojourning at Philomelium and to all the sojournings of the holy and universal church in every place. May mercy and peace and love from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ be multiplied.
Brothers, we have written to you about those who suffered martyrdom and about the blessed Polycarp. Having sealed it all through his martyrdom, he brought the persecution to an end.

Nearly everything that led up to it happened so that the Lord from above might show us the martyrdom according to the gospel. Polycarp waited to be handed over, just as the Lord did, so that we too might become his imitators, looking not only to our own interests but also to the interests of our neighbors (Philippians 2:4). True and steadfast love does not seek its own salvation only, but the salvation of all the brothers as well.
